descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The ride of your life, from the seat - all the way round Minneapolis.

YOUR GARAGE
Start astride your bike in a luxury three-car garage by I-394. Touch the throttle and the door lifts onto the road.

THE BIKE
A litre-class sport bike: a live colour dash with speed, gear, lean angle and a map, two live mirrors, a smoked bubble screen.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
Grip the bars with your own hands. Roll your right wrist back to open the throttle, brake with your left hand, push the bars to lean into a corner. Tuck behind the screen for top speed, or turn wheelie control off and lift the front.

39 KM OF REAL MINNEAPOLIS
I-394 into downtown, I-94 north past North Loop, Broadway over the Mississippi through Northeast, then I-35W over the St. Anthony Falls Bridge with the falls and the Stone Arch Bridge beside you, past the stadium and down through the Lake Street trench, west on the Crosstown and north on Highway 100 by the Chain of Lakes.

ROAD EVENTS + SPEED TRAPS
Seven events on real roads - race for gold against your own ghost bike. Six speed cameras, and Rush Hour near-miss combos on I-35W.

SUNSET, DAY AND NIGHT
Golden hour over the river, bright sun, or the city at night on your headlight with the traffic's tail lights ahead.

YOUR WAY
Choose how much the view leans, bar vibration on or off, automatic or a six-speed sequential box. Speeds in mph. English and Spanish.
